chunks: "There is no blame on you today," he said, "May God forgive you. He is the most merciful of all."

key_terms.أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ: The most merciful of the merciful

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Joseph say to his brothers when he forgave them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration by Prophet Joseph (peace be upon him) is viewed as a culmination of his patience and a model of magnanimity, demonstrating how divine forgiveness transcends human retribution. The phrase 'no blame upon you' (la thariba) signifies the removal of the cause for reproach, reflecting the broader theological principle that God's mercy encompasses all things, a theme reinforced by the attribute 'Arham al-Rahimin' (Most Merciful of the merciful). This event serves as a practical example of *adab* (etiquette) in reconciliation, showing that true nobility lies in forgiving those who wronged you.
